auggie-prd-api.instructions: Auggie is LP's AI engineering assistant. Tools: `ask_auggie` (submit task → returns taskId/conversationId), `get_task_status` (poll for result; pending/running/completed). Async only — wait 15-30s between polls. Most tasks complete in 1-3 min. See the auggie skill (auto-loads on triggers) for prompt-crafting and follow-up patterns.

linear.instructions: Linear is LP's issue tracker. The MCP server exposes the standard Linear tools (issues, projects, teams, comments, status updates, labels, cycles). For `clanq-dm`, your access level is governed by which Linear API key OneCLI injects — full access for cli-with-luis and clanq-dm; read-only for clanq-channels (write attempts will 401/403). When citing tickets, prefer the Linear ID (e.g. `ENG-1234`) plus a one-line title.

notion.instructions: Notion is LP's docs / wiki / planning surface. The MCP server exposes Notion tools (search pages/databases, query, create-page, update-page, append-block, etc.). Routed through MintMCP — auth + page-permission scope is configured server-side at the MintMCP gateway, not here. When citing Notion content, prefer page title + a permalink so the reader can verify.
